ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: in the figure is a structure similar to a stilbene/cinnamic acid derivative, with one benzene ring on the left and one on the right, a carboxylic acid group labeled CO2H connected near the double bond, and there are also several mechanism curved arrows and an H label in the figure, but the problem asks to ignore these arrows. Then reason: keeping only the atom connectivity, it can be seen that the main skeleton is an alkene, with the two benzene rings connected on the two sides of the double bond respectively, and one double-bond carbon connected to the carboxylic acid group. According to the relative configuration shown in the figure, using slashes to indicate the double-bond stereochemical relationship, the obtained SMILES is O=C(O)/C(=C/c1ccccc1)c1ccccc1. Final answer: O=C(O)/C(=C/c1ccccc1)c1ccccc1

raw_record.question_text: What is the SMILES expression of the transition-state structure shown in the image, ignoring the arrows?

method.method_draft: First describe the image: it shows a stilbene-like alkene bearing two phenyl rings, with a carboxylic acid substituent labeled CO2H on one alkene carbon and mechanistic curved arrows that the question says to ignore. Then convert only the connectivity into SMILES: start from the carboxylic acid as O=C(O)-, attach it to the substituted alkene carbon, make that carbon double-bonded to the other alkene carbon bearing the left phenyl group, and attach the second phenyl group to the carboxyl-substituted alkene carbon. Encode the drawn opposite-side arrangement of CO2H and the left phenyl across the double bond with matching stereochemical slashes, yielding O=C(O)/C(=C/c1ccccc1)c1ccccc1.
method.CoT_raw: 先描述图像：图中是一个类似二苯乙烯/肉桂酸衍生物的结构，左侧和右侧各有一个苯环，双键附近连有一个标注为 CO2H 的羧酸基，图里还有几条机制弯箭和一个 H 标记，但题目要求忽略这些箭头。再推理：只保留原子连接关系，可见主骨架是一个烯烃，两个苯环分别连在双键两侧，其中一个双键碳连着羧酸基。按图中所示的相对构型，用斜杠表示双键立体关系，得到的 SMILES 为 O=C(O)/C(=C/c1ccccc1)c1ccccc1。最终答案：O=C(O)/C(=C/c1ccccc1)c1ccccc1

planner_metadata.image_role: Use the image to identify the actual molecular skeleton: two benzene rings, a central C=C alkene, a CO2H group attached to one alkene carbon, one phenyl attached to that same alkene carbon, and the other phenyl attached to the opposite alkene carbon; ignore the curved arrows, radical/dot-like marks, and mechanistic motion indicators.
planner_metadata.text_role: Use the question text to know the required output is a SMILES expression and that all arrows in the transition-state drawing must be ignored.
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: Apply skeletal-structure conventions: unlabeled vertices are carbons with implicit hydrogens, benzene rings are aromatic phenyl groups written as c1ccccc1, CO2H is written as O=C(O)-, and slash/backslash notation around C=C records the trans/E relationship visible in the drawing.
